stations.title: Bridie
stations.say: It has said five minutes all day.

stations.title: Ossian's lines
stations.text: Say the same minute, over and over

stations.title: Boarding gate
stations.text: Counts down, then closes on time.

captions: The boarding gate at the quay. Bridie wants a countdown that reaches the end.
Ossian's countdown says the same minute again and again, and never stops.
You write loops: a countdown, the departures, a running total, a search.
Now the countdown moves on each minute and the gate closes when it should.
while, for and break. Next, Bridie wants the rules in pieces she can reuse.
